name: example-jp-ops-console
title: Ops Console Settings
description: Restrained light SaaS ops console settings page: 260px sidebar with grouped navigation and an active-card link, topbar with save-draft and apply actions, three KPI cards, a notification-settings form with visible help and error rows, and a job-status table with pill badges — all on a 12-column grid with one soft-blue accent. Use when the brief mentions "settings page", "admin console", "internal tool", "workflow settings", "back office UI". Based on hirokaji's jp-ui-contracts sample.

query.en: Build a calm SaaS admin settings console — sidebar navigation, KPI cards, a notification settings form, and a job status table.
